title: Conformal Prediction with Stable Measurement Mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2610.34204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In applications such as air-quality monitoring, inexpensive sensor readings can help predict pollutant concentrations measured by a separate reference instrument. We study how to adapt conformal prediction intervals to a new population when reference outcomes are available in the source data, but only sensor readings and context, such as weather conditions, are available in the target. We assume that the measurement distribution at a given outcome and context remains stable, while context frequencies and outcome distributions may change. This model is a particular form of causal mechanism shift. Its statistical restriction has been studied as sparse joint shift. Using established marginal matching, predictive adjustment, and weighted conformal calibration, we examine what this restriction contributes to coverage and interval length for continuous outcomes. translated_title: 基于稳定测量机制的保形预测
translated_abstract: 在空气质量监测等应用中，廉价的传感器读数可以帮助预测由独立参考仪器测量的污染物浓度。我们研究当源数据中可以获得参考结果，而目标数据中仅有传感器读数和上下文信息（如天气条件）时，如何将保形预测区间适配到新的总体。我们假设在给定结果和上下文的条件下，测量分布保持稳定，而上下文频率和结果分布可能发生变化。该模型是因果机制偏移的一种特殊形式，其统计限制已被作为稀疏联合偏移加以研究。利用已有的边缘匹配、预测调整和加权保形校准方法，我们考察了这一限制对连续结果的覆盖率和区间长度的作用。高斯分析展示了测量稳定性如何识别结果变化。
tldr: 该论文提出在“测量机制稳定”的因果假设下，将保形预测区间从拥有参考结果的源数据适配到仅有传感器读数的目标总体，并分析了这一稳定性限制对预测覆盖率与区间长度的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts conformal prediction intervals to a new target population under a stable measurement mechanism assumption, showing how this causal restriction improves coverage and interval length when reference outcomes are unavailable in the target data.
